# HAPI v0.27.3.6

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- **Drops the fork-carried PR #1093 (assistant response navigation)** per the 2026-08-15 operator ruling: the jump-to-conversation-start / jump-to-turn-input buttons and their whole navigation stack (`NavigationButton`, `ConversationStartStatus`, `jumpToPrompt`/`scrollToConversationStart`, `buildAssistantReplyTargets`, related icons, locale keys, and tests) are removed from the fork. The upstream PR stays open; our related issue reports were closed (#1587) or re-scoped (#1586 to the four official action buttons).
- New carries (4): #1584 (CLI status summaries follow the conversation language), #1585 (AGY supports Gemini 3.7 Flash in the model list/picker), #1592 (reasoning collapse preference also applies to history), #1595 (Ctrl+A select-all restored on the chat page, with e2e wiring).
- Deferred: #1590 (quiet active sessions pinned section) — conflicts with the fork's project-group context menu (#955), attached-jobs pin mode, and machine-label UX; will carry after the conflicts are resolved or the upstream merge lands.
- Upstream unchanged since `901f17d0c` (official v0.27.4 not yet released); this is a carry + fork-cleanup release on the same base.
- Standing ledger: #1091 stays `drop` (operator ruling 2026-08-13), #1320 permanently excluded.

## Compared with the official release

- Same maintained overlay as `v0.27.3.5` (session-roots guard, #906 steer superset, migration ladder, fork release pipeline, session-jobs #1404) on official HAPI `v0.27.3` + upstream `901f17d0c`, minus the dropped #1093 navigation feature, plus the four carries above.
- Uses four-part version `0.27.3.6`; platform optional dependencies remain pinned to official `0.27.3`.
